explanation: studySelection.test.tsx now tests the study-selection module at its interface, parameterized by report kind (empty selections never widen, selections survive a term remount, link bytes round-trip, the panel wording), importing the value and URL form from studySelectionLink.ts. lazyChunkBoundaries.test.ts gains an entry-graph walk from main.tsx that reads each file's syntax tree with the TypeScript 6 API, skips only compiler-erased type imports, resolves specifiers with bundler resolution (so ./x.js finds x.ts), fails on any unresolved relative runtime import and fails if either evidence ledger is reachable. The App gene and pathway scope tests keep one copied-link smoke each plus a check that a category toggle does not remount the report. geneStudyScope.test.ts and the useCategoryScope tests are removed; report and router tests pass the new selection props.
